summary: Ares Strategic Income Fund filed an 8-K on October 2, 2026, disclosing its Board's position on an unsolicited mini-tender by Cox Capital Partners and affiliates, seeking up to 431,965 Class I shares at $23.15 per share — roughly a 13% discount to the August 31, 2026 NAV — representing under 0.14% of outstanding Class I shares. The Board determined the offer is neither advisable nor in shareholders' best interests, unanimously recommending rejection; the Fund is unaffiliated with Cox. A near-identical July 2026 mini-tender drew no participation. Watch for tender withdrawals, expiration, and any tender-related arbitrage overhang.
